summary: Frontend-only validation of the new read-only 'Program Overview' screen (/program-overview) for the migrated account user_b@theprogram.app (userId dab8da9f, currentWeek ~15, 52 weeks, 7 phases). Logged in via /api/auth/login, seeded auth_token+auth_user in localStorage, navigated Programs -> tapped 'View full program' -> /program-overview. Screen renders correctly: 'Full Program' header with back button, plan name, 'You are in Week 15 of 52' banner, deload legend, and all 7 PHASE cards each with correct week ranges, block rows (name, Wk range, goal, colored Heavy/Speed Lower/Upper session dots, and numbered week pills 1..52). Current-week pill (15) is visually highlighted with the accent color (rgb(201,168,76)); deload weeks show the moon icon on wks 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 38, 42, 46, 50 (per-block deloads on the future portion of the migrated plan, exactly as required). The screen is scrollable through all 7 phases and Off-Season block 4 ends at week 52. Back button returns to /programs. Read-only confirmed: no Edit/Save/Delete/Add controls or pencil icon on the overview. Entry point is reachable directly from the Programs active card (not gated behind today's session state).

issues: Current-week arithmetic is inconsistent between the two screens: /programs shows 'Week 16 of 52' (programs.tsx uses Math.round((now-start)/week)+1) while /program-overview banner shows 'Week 15 of 52' (program-overview.tsx uses Math.floor((now-start)/week)+1 in currentWeekOfPlan). Both derive from the same plan.startDate, so the week label should match. Recommend consolidating both to a single helper (or using plan.currentWeek from the backend if available) so the banner, pill highlight, and the programs card are consistent.

Plan name renders as the literal string 'Apr 11, 2026 → Apr 10, 2027' at the top of the overview (from plan.name), then immediately below 'Started Apr 6, 2026 · 4 days/week' is shown. This is a migrated-account data quirk (name was seeded to a date range) but visually the header duplicates date info and the 'Started Apr 6' date doesn't line up with the name's 'Apr 11'. Consider falling back to plan.planName (e.g. 'Hypertrophy — 52 Week Program') when plan.name looks like an auto-generated date range.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages to replace the required functionality.' Not caused by program-overview.tsx, but present app-wide and should be migrated. Reference: package.json / anywhere expo-av is imported.

Console warns: 'No route named "onboarding" exists in nested children'. The root layout references an 'onboarding' route that doesn't exist in /app/frontend/app/ (only onboarding-intake.tsx and onboarding-path-picker.tsx exist). Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. App-wide (not specific to program-overview).
Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' App-wide.

action_items: Unify current-week calculation across /programs and /program-overview (single helper or backend-provided plan.currentWeek). Right now programs card says 'Week 16' while overview banner says 'Week 15' for the exact same active plan.
Consider a nicer fallback for plan.name when it was auto-generated as a date range on migrated accounts (fall back to plan.planName in the ProgramOverview header).
Migrate expo-av to expo-audio / expo-video before SDK 54 (deprecation warning at runtime).
Remove the stale 'onboarding' route reference in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (route does not exist under app/).

Add data-testid/testID props to the ProgramOverview screen (backBtn, nowBanner, phase cards, week pills, current-week pill) to make automated verification more robust; currently there are no testIDs on the new screen.
critical_code_review_comments: program-overview.tsx defines its own currentWeekOfPlan (Math.floor + 1) that diverges from programs.tsx's version (Math.round + 1). Extract this into src/utils/plan.ts and use everywhere.

program-overview.tsx has no testID props on any interactive/critical element (back button, banner, phase cards, pills). Adding testIDs is inexpensive and aligned with the project's testing conventions.

MaterialCommunityIcons name='weather-night' is used as the deload marker. The banner and legend are clear, but the pill uses only the moon icon + week number (no aria-label / accessibility label). Consider accessibilityLabel='Week {n}, deload week' for a11y.

rca_of_issue: Minor UX/consistency issue: 'Week X of 52' differs by 1 between /programs (Math.round) and /program-overview (Math.floor). Both start from the same plan.startDate and Date.now(). Reproduction: log in as user_b, open /programs (shows 'Week 16 of 52'), tap 'View full program' (banner shows 'Week 15 of 52'). Fix: consolidate to one helper in /app/frontend/src/utils/ (recommend Math.floor+1 to match 'weeks completed + current' semantics, or use backend-provided plan.currentWeek) and import in both screens.
